component.name: ClipHarbor
component.summary: Download videos and audio from YouTube and other sites

description.p: ClipHarbor is a free downloader for videos and audio from YouTube and the many other sites yt-dlp supports. Paste a link and pick what you want: there are no ads, no accounts and no limits.

ul.li: Video in MP4, MKV or WebM, up to 8K, or audio as MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV
Whole playlists and channels at once
Subscriptions that fetch new videos from channels you follow
Download just part of a video, or turn it into a GIF or WebP
Shrink a video to fit a size limit, such as Discord's
Subtitles, thumbnails and details saved into the file
Skip sponsor segments in YouTube videos with SponsorBlock
A browser extension to send the page you're on to ClipHarbor

description.p: Only download videos you have the right to keep.

screenshot.caption: The download list in the dark look

description.p: Fixes for pausing and resuming quickly, and for two videos with the same title.
